scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts && npm run typecheck -w @safestep/extension && npm run typecheck -w @safestep/api
scripts.build: npm run contracts && npm run build -w @safestep/api && npm run build -w @safestep/extension
scripts.dev: npm run contracts && npm run dev -w @safestep/extension
scripts.api: npm run contracts && npm run build -w @safestep/api && npm start -w @safestep/api
